note: One row per real exam. Windows and months are what USUALLY happens, never this year's exact dates — a student is always sent to the official site. A 'checked' row was compared with published reporting of the official notice on checked_on; a 'draft' row shows only its name and official link until it is checked. The monthly study bot (housekeeping/studyRefresh.js) re-checks rows on their official sites and the admin approves any change. A fixture fails if a checked row is older than 13 months.

review.note: Owner gate (Round 11): read the rows once.
